title: Use EDCoPilot music
desc: If ON and music folders have been set below, EDCoPilot will play music when you are docking, in combat, or doing some exploration/cruising.

title: Music volume
desc: Adjust the volume level of the music player (0 to 100)

title: Reduce music volume by x% when there are announcements
desc: Temporarily reduce the current volume level by x% when an announcement is made (0 to 100). Example if current music volume is 20 and this is set to 50%, music will reduce to 10% while voice is speaking

title: Docking music folder location
desc: Set this to a folder containing mp3s to be played when you are docking

title: Combat music folder location
desc: Set this to a folder containing mp3s to be played when you are in combat

title: Exploration music folder location
desc: Set this to a folder containing mp3s to be played when you are exploring or travelling

title: Time Trials music folder location
desc: Set this to a folder containing mp3s to be played when you are running a Time Trial

title: Use music subfolders based on your being in Ship, SRV, Fighter or OnFoot
desc: If ON, EDCoPilot will use separate playlists from subfolders SRV, Ship, Fighter or OnFoot within your music folders, based on your current situation.

title: Play Docking Music
desc: Enable / disable music playing when you dock

title: Play Combat Music
desc: Enable / disable music playing when you are in combat

title: Play Exploration Music
desc: Enable / disable music playing when you are exploring or travelling

title: Play Time Trial Music
desc: Enable / disable music playing when you are running a Time Trial

title: Turn off music on docking
desc: If on, music will stop once you dock. If OFF, will continue playing

title: Stop current music if switching to a theme that is not enabled
desc: If ON, when trying to auto-switch to a theme, will stop music playing if the new theme is not enabled. If OFF, will continue playing the current (enabled) theme

title: Continue last song when switching back to a theme (works on MP3s only)
desc: If ON, and the song previously played in the theme was an MP3, will attempt to play from last recorded position. If OFF, will skip to next track in the list

title: Combat music cooldown period
desc: Specify number of seconds combat music will continue to play after combat ends, before theme switches back to exploration
